date_anchor.meaning: authorized disposable validation run date in Asia/Kolkata
date_anchor.historical_dates: invented scenario offsets only; never production backfill evidence

loader_contract: Specification only. Apply after explicit approval through full-chain validated fixtures. Resolve references to IDs. Keep constraints and guards enabled. Construct isolated historical versions with corresponding events; do not alter clock or production RPC guards.

repeat_variant.description: Use only for E14; changes dates of A_S1 and A_S2 in isolated database before placements exist. No second simultaneously active overlapping academic year.

scenarios.setup: S1 complete registration in A; verify SN001/R001; create initial episode, approve admission, place on D, activate
scenarios.expected: Stable student/user IDs unchanged; approval is distinct from account approval; one active episode, verified placement, ordered creation/approval/identifier/placement/activation events and audit. No fabricated date; admission explicitly D.

scenarios.setup: Pending account registration; approve admission/prepare placement then attempt activation
scenarios.expected: 23514/controlled validation error; account remains pending, enrollment remains pending_admission, no activation event/audit or version change. No current academic entitlement.

scenarios.setup: Reject pending admission; retry same operation; try approve rejected episode
scenarios.expected: First reject -> cancelled/rejected with reason/closure D; retry returns original result without second event; later approval fails. Identity/history retained.

scenarios.setup: Cancel unactivated application without placements
scenarios.expected: cancelled lifecycle, prior admission decision preserved; no current access. Reconsideration creates new successor rather than rewriting event. A prepared-placement cancellation is deliberately blocked by draft pending a reviewed cancellation adapter; no history deletion.

scenarios.setup: Program NULL, year/semester missing, or only legacy registration date
scenarios.expected: Pending can persist; approve without program fails; unknown legacy -> legacy_unresolved snapshot and no placement/current access. Legacy date preserved as provenance, not admission date.

scenarios.setup: Program A2 with claimed B year/semester or semester/year mismatch
scenarios.expected: Tenant helper/composite FK rejects (23514 or 23503), no placement/event committed. Correct tenant-local IDs succeed only with valid dates.

scenarios.setup: S1 closed A episode with R001; readmit to A using existing identifiers
scenarios.expected: New enrollment ID and predecessor; original student/identifier IDs reused; old episode/events/marks untouched; one operational episode after activation.

scenarios.setup: S2 claims S1's normalized R001, including surrounding tabs/spaces
scenarios.expected: 23505 collision; no identifier reassign, no new episode version/event/audit; submitted unverified claim cannot seize permanent ownership.

scenarios.setup: A and B each issue R001 to different students; `0007` versus `7`, case variation

inputs.kind_collision: register matches S1, roll matches S2

scenarios.expected: Different tenant identifiers coexist; leading-zero variants remain distinct; case is preserved by safe default. Same-tenant normalized trim duplicate rejects. Cross-kind untyped-login ambiguity fails closed rather than choosing a person.

scenarios.setup: Transfer A -> B: prepare/approve destination; source authorization names destination final prepared version; execute handoff on D
scenarios.expected: Two institutions' durable decisions and current authority verified; source transferred_out/closed D; destination active/admitted D; two events share one operation/correlation and canonical request; old publication/owners unchanged.

scenarios.setup: Transfer destination pending/rejected, source consent absent/stale, changed destination version, source admin revoked or destination approver revoked
scenarios.expected: Handoff fails with controlled denial/conflict; source remains operational; no partial closures/new activation/events/audit. Destination failure never strands source. Identical retry after authority revocation is denied.

scenarios.setup: A1 -> A2 program change; approved successor/handoff
scenarios.expected: Same student/institution, new episode/program; prior withdrawn with program-change provenance. Changing known program on existing episode is rejected. Same-program successor rejected.

scenarios.setup: Historical S1 semester-1 placement ends on D; promote to ordinal 2 placement
scenarios.expected: Adjacent `[start,D)` / `[D,end)` intervals accepted; old placement preserved, new ID and progression event. Overlapping/equal-start replacement rejects; event failure rolls back any old interval closure.

scenarios.setup: Repeat ordinal 1 using different year/semester UUID
scenarios.expected: Attempt advances from 1 to 2; concrete semester changed but curriculum ordinal same. Skipping to attempt 4 or reusing attempt 1 outside leave resumption fails. Old attendance/results remain original attempt.

scenarios.setup: Supplementary test conducted after original placement period
scenarios.expected: Bind to evidenced original assessment/attempt, no fake new placement or automatic promotion. New publication edition/type must coexist after future result-uniqueness migration; current consolidated key blocks this and is a cutover blocker. No overwrite of original result.

scenarios.setup: S1 active placement started before D; leave on D; seed prior leave for isolated resume-on-D test

inputs.resume_scenario: isolated prior leave D-10 then place/resume D

scenarios.expected: Leave keeps approved same episode and IDs, closes interval D; blocks current assessments/content entitlement. Resume requires new evidenced placement on D and approved account; same attempt permitted; no second episode.

scenarios.setup: Withdraw or graduate on D; then attempt resume on terminal row
scenarios.expected: Proper terminal status/closure, placement closed only with nonempty valid interval; resume fails. Published historical records still eligible under approved historical policy. Further admission uses readmission.

scenarios.setup: Faculty creates UNREGISTERED roster and records attendance/test marks before S1 registration

inputs.late_identity: new synthetic PRE001 identity after records

scenarios.expected: Nullable student links remain valid; no synthetic student/episode; staff/faculty workflows continue. Later verified identity reconciliation links only uniquely supported period/attempt, preserves session/mark keys and unresolved conflict states.

scenarios.setup: Register and roll resolve to different people; multiple same-person subject rosters
scenarios.expected: Conflicting identifiers -> CONFLICT, no link/publication; same-person multiple sections is legitimate and reconciles per subject/date. Pending registration remains PENDING_APPROVAL, not ACTIVE.

scenarios.setup: Forge identifier of wrong kind/owner/tenant, predecessor of S2, placement of another episode, foreign correction reference
scenarios.expected: Child guards/composite FKs reject; no changed state/event. Public endpoint returns safe error without foreign identifiers/labels; every supplied reference checked.

scenarios.setup: Transfer/graduate S1 with published result, withheld result, notification and past attendance in A
scenarios.expected: Original student/institution/program/year/semester/status/marks unchanged. Own historical published read succeeds if A active/policy permits; withheld/draft and another student's records hidden. Mark-read updates only read fields and preserves A tenant.

scenarios.setup: Historical context for A with current episode B; resources/notices/AI/upcoming queries
scenarios.expected: Historical academic A data permitted only by historical policy. A history does not confer current A resources, notices or upcoming sections. Current B content remains scoped; safe AI context corresponds to selected permitted records and contains no private event payload.

scenarios.setup: Inactive/archived A or inactive/deactivated account; only legacy_unresolved episode
scenarios.expected: Default historical/current access denied; no opportunistic selection of another tenant/current semester. Policy exception, if approved later, must be tested separately; does not alter publication.

scenarios.setup: Two sessions issue different lifecycle commands with same expected version
scenarios.expected: Exactly one successful commit; loser stale version 40001/HTTP409 or serialization retry then stale conflict. One transition event/audit per winner; no duplicate operational episode.

scenarios.setup: Two identical same-key commands concurrently; retry after later successful state change; same key with changed action/args/actor/target
scenarios.expected: Identical requests return same original result/version; no duplicate event/audit. Changed envelope rejects 23514; authentication/authority rechecked before replay. Two-episode handoff retries return both original endpoint responses.

scenarios.setup: Concurrent activation of two approved episodes for S1; concurrent overlapping placement writes; simultaneous identifier claim by S1/S2
scenarios.expected: Student lock/partial unique index permits one operational episode; exclusive interval/expected version permits one valid placement; unique owner key gives one identifier owner. No history truncated to satisfy uniqueness.

scenarios.setup: Inject event INSERT failure, audit INSERT failure, or future reconciliation/notification-intent failure after state update
scenarios.expected: Entire transaction fails; enrollment version/state, identifiers/placement closure/new placement/events/audit/required intent unchanged. No success response or external delivery. Injected failure triggers exist only in approved disposable fixture transaction.

scenarios.setup: Client anon/authenticated reads/writes/truncates new tables or calls every command/helper overload, including legitimate application admin JWT
scenarios.expected: Permission denied 42501 before accessing rows/routine. No column-level/inherited/default/PUBLIC escape. Service direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE also denied; sanctioned service RPC succeeds only with active scoped admin + granular permission.

scenarios.setup: Service supplies foreign tenant/admin lacking permission; faculty calls lifecycle RPC; forged role/body fields
scenarios.expected: 42501 or safe not-found before mutation. Existing faculty attendance/test APIs still work with their established authority. Super-admin alone is not a tenant enrollment admin.

scenarios.setup: UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE events as service and ordinary owner with triggers enabled; correction annotation; deletion of actor/identity
scenarios.expected: Service denied by ACL; ordinary owner event modification/truncate rejected by trigger. Correction appends one event referencing earlier same-episode event; prior bytes unchanged. Actor/identity deletion blocked by restrictive history FKs. Owner disabling guards is maintenance authority, not an asserted impossible action.

scenarios.setup: Tamper a core RLS/policy/grant/index/trigger binding then run approved postflight; old authority table exposed
scenarios.expected: Assertions raise exception; no successful migration commit. Include column-only grant, PUBLIC routine EXECUTE, inherited bypass role, extra overload/policy and removed sequence/idempotency key.

scenarios.setup: Change master ancestry/calendar while placements exist
scenarios.expected: Existing ancestry-ID updates rejected by master guard. Future approved master-calendar adapter rejects bounds excluding existing placements; unchanged draft lacks that cross-child check, so this acceptance test blocks cutover until adapter implemented. Do not disable master guard.

scenarios.setup: Switch A/B/history context while delayed request resolves; logout/cross-tab account change
scenarios.expected: Old context response discarded, context-scoped caches cleared/rekeyed; no previous account/institution academic data shown. Same token changing context must still rekey.

scenarios.setup: Legacy fixtures with zero/two matching episode candidates, alternate program_courses schema and unknown inactive meaning
scenarios.expected: Mapping deterministic or explicitly unresolved; no fabricated dates/program/attempt. Preserve IDs/publication/counts. Both curriculum baseline variants converge through actual migration; no skipped migration to make fixture pass.

scenarios.setup: Future effective command, backdated RPC, same-day zero-length leave/transfer after placement start, cancellation with prepared placement
scenarios.expected: Draft rejects operational unsupported date/empty interval/cleanup case without effects. Schedule by storing pending decision and issuing command on effective day. Institution-approved historical corrections/cancellation cleanup need a separate reviewed routine, not a bypass flag.
